name: bob-code-consistency-review-scaffold
description: Scaffold for bob code consistency pre-review MVP tooling.

scripts.unit: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/review-input-validator.test.js dist/tests/bob-output-validator.test.js dist/tests/git-diff-collector.test.js dist/tests/review-package-builder.test.js
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:help && npm run smoke:preprocess && npm run smoke:validate-output && npm run smoke:triage
scripts.smoke:preprocess: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js preprocess --input tests/fixtures/review-input.valid.yaml --out .tmp/review-package --diff-fixture tests/fixtures/diff-summary.valid.json
scripts.smoke:validate-output: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js validate-output --package .tmp/review-package --bob-output tests/fixtures/bob-output.valid.yaml
scripts.smoke:triage: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js triage --package .tmp/review-package --bob-output tests/fixtures/bob-output.valid.yaml --out .tmp/human-triage
